catalog.projection: public spell preimage + patch; no review/support
conditionPatches.fields + card fieldPatches; no generated certificates
mechanics of effects present in this minimal public catalog only; item patches/new high-level effects excluded; generic pools remain virtual

fixture.source: checked-in canonical catalog plus synthetic test creatures

cacheConditions.server: Fresh catalog for each initialization; persistent process. Worker cache hit is measured. OS/PG caches are not flushed.
cacheConditions.seed: Server-generated per encounter; exact receipt replay compares full results. Different encounters are not claimed to share a seed.

conditions.navigation: New document each sample; warm HTTP cache is explicitly primed. Application in-memory caches reset on navigation.
conditions.readiness: Network quiet includes Playwright 500 ms quiet window; not a user-input latency metric.
conditions.interaction: Playwright click/hover observation includes automation overhead; hover waits two animation frames. Click-to-commit excludes human decision time. These are not INP.
conditions.media: External URLs blocked by local stand; PWA service worker blocked.
conditions.inp: Event Timing entries are samples, not a complete web-vitals INP implementation; absent values remain unmeasured.
conditions.reactProfiler: Standard production React build does not expose component commit profiles; Chrome CPU/task metrics reported separately.

interpretation.gzip: Per-file gzip estimate; actual HTTP encoding/cache is measured by browser resources.
interpretation.routes: Static JS dependency closure plus separately named route CSS. CSS inherited from other chunks and dynamic preload CSS are not assigned to routes here; browser resource timings measure actual CSS bytes.
interpretation.dynamicImports: Reachability edges only, not proof of initial download.
interpretation.pwa: Parsed emitted service worker precache URLs; browser baseline blocks service worker, so this is separate install cost.
interpretation.allAssets: Includes lazy code/media/public files; never an initial-load budget.
